acceptanceTopology.requiredDecision: One authenticated OWNER comment from ndrewtran on issue #11 must bind the exact candidate path, canonical byte length, SHA-256 digest, Decision 0007 and receipt digests, Product Scope 4.0.2 digest, all 28 predecessor certificate identities, the two-root capture topology, and the explicit no-scope-growth boundary. Any candidate-byte or topology change requires a new digest-specific decision.

changeControlEffects.accessibility: No manual accessibility acceptance or native assistive-technology behavior is granted. G1.2 retains only the roadmap-owned automated substrate assertions and explicit nonclaims.
changeControlEffects.architecture: No architecture amendment. The existing proof architecture already permits one digest-linked successor after later source-only drift when a new human-accepted authority decision closes the path.
changeControlEffects.authoring: Adds one append-only decision and receipt, a decision-specific validator and negative corpus, a test-owned atomic G1.2 capture/profile, and two new evidence roots after acceptance. Existing evidence bytes remain immutable.
changeControlEffects.compatibility: No public schema, query, token contract, catalog, renderer, binding, lifecycle, support range, package publication, or consumer migration change. The private experimental @core-ui/react-native implementation remains separately reviewed.
changeControlEffects.privacy: All retained evidence is public-repository-sanitized. No credentials, local absolute paths, consumer code, prompts, screenshots, traces, device identifiers, or unrelated payloads may enter either root.
changeControlEffects.productScope: No Product Scope version, Scope ID, commitment, deliverable, non-goal, support cell, release boundary, or milestone meaning changes. Product Scope remains 4.0.2.
changeControlEffects.proof: The 28 continuation certificates preserve superseded status and integrity lineage only; they cannot satisfy G1.2 or any historical assertion. Only the separate five-record G1.2 root may be proposed for G1.2 acceptance.
changeControlEffects.release: No package version, publication, readiness, merge, Gate 1, or release claim follows from this decision.
changeControlEffects.security: Capture is local, deterministic, atomic, fail-closed, source/tree-bound, and denies partial publication, overwrite, fork, stale predecessor, malformed receipt, or private-path disclosure.

commitmentTransitions: none; all 12 affectedScopeIds remain committed at their existing Product Scope 4.0.2 meanings

continuityTopology.currentManifestRule: For each target, recompute core-ui-path-manifest-v1 from the exact predecessor currentApplicabilityManifest.paths at the frozen source commit; require a digest different from predecessorCurrentApplicabilityManifest.sha256 and bind the exact frozen sourceRevision/sourceTree.
continuityTopology.successorRule: Append exactly one certificate per target. Each certificate must use schema core-ui-evidence-applicability-supersession-v1, bind previousSupersession to the exact Decision-0007 terminal certificate, set supersededApplicabilityManifest byte-for-byte equal to that predecessor currentApplicabilityManifest, preserve the predecessor replacementPlan and affectedAssertions, omit supersededRecertification, and remain evidenceStatus superseded.

decision.rationale: The G1.2 importer, lockfile, package graph, and proof-tool closure change applicability bytes covered by all 28 terminal Decision-0007 certificates. Those certificates are append-only leaves and Decision 0007 intentionally requires a new owner decision before a successor-of-successor continuation. A single versioned maintenance root closes all 28 chains without rewriting history, while a separate root keeps G1.2 proof semantically independent.
decision.result: Authorize one versioned successor-of-successor maintenance root containing exactly 28 zero-record continuations and one separate fresh G1.2 proof root containing exactly E-G1.2-01 through E-G1.2-05, captured atomically from one frozen source commit after this decision is accepted.

g12ProofTopology.applicabilityOwnership: The profile derives its applicability manifest from the exact frozen product/proof source paths declared by the G1.2 owner; it does not reuse any superseded certificate as proof.

platformBoundary.android: test-only native substrate and validation-profile observation
platformBoundary.ios: test-only native substrate and validation-profile observation
platformBoundary.reactNativeWeb: explicit unsupported or adapted substrate disposition; never inherited web.react parity

No successor certificate may satisfy E-G1.2-01 through E-G1.2-05 or any historical milestone assertion.

No acceptance of the current dirty G1.2 implementation; its generator, public type/accessibility surface, invariant ownership, proof write set, and negative corpus remain subject to correction and independent review.

rollback.afterEvidenceRetention: Never delete or rewrite either retained root. A later source drift requires another human-accepted decision and a new uniquely versioned continuation root; withdrawn G1.2 proof uses the future applicable append-only mechanism.
rollback.beforeEvidenceCommit: Delete only uncommitted generated roots after verifying their exact transaction paths; revert the source commit normally if publication is abandoned.
rollback.partialFailure: Rollback both generated roots, verify both final paths are absent, preserve the original error as cause, and fail with a stable rollback-integrity diagnostic if any reversal or cleanup fails.

sourceBoundary.evidenceChild: one evidence-only child with the frozen source commit as sole parent
sourceBoundary.finalSource: derived only after the accepted decision and all G1.2 source/proof corrections are frozen; the capture must bind its exact commit and tree
sourceBoundary.publicationTopology: one protected implementation pull request containing the accepted authority/source commit followed by the evidence-only child

trackerReconciliation.blockedBy: Replace only the Decision-0007-only continuity blocker with the accepted Decision-0008 continuation route; retain that G1.2 evidence and acceptance remain pending.

trackerReconciliation.timing: Only after the exact digest-specific Decision-0008 acceptance receipt is recorded. Tracker state is not acceptance proof.
trackerReconciliation.workflowSemantics: API-unverified; perform exact field mutation only through the accepted authority map and reread the live item afterward.
